supothita.p: [ su + putha + ta. Nīti, dhātu. 311. ] (ti) Google Translate (1) well-punched-crushed-necessary. (2) Severely insulted - beaten - given.

P: Supoṭhita，[su+poṭhita] well beaten； perhaps at Miln．415 for suthita （said of iron）； （nt．） a good thrashing DhA．I，48．（Page 719）

supothita：သု-ပေါထိတ （တိ）

suporisa.p: [ su + porisa. Su + porisa-saṃ. Su + poriya-prā. ] (pu) Google Translate good man Wise.

suposa.p: [ su + pusa. Nīti, dhātu. 174. Supoၑ-prā. ] (ti) Google Translate Rich-and-easy-to-feed Easy to feed.

DOP: 2 posa m. [ S. poṣa], nourishing; supporting; Dhātum 441 (pusa ~amhi); — dupposa , mfn. [ S. lex. duṣpoṣa], hard to nourish or support; Vin I 45, 20 (bhagavā … dubbharatāya ~-tāya … avaṇṇaṃ bhāsitvā); S I 61, 12* (~aṃ katvā attānaṃ); Ps I 96, 29 (ekacco attano pi upaṭṭhākānaṃ pi dubbharo hoti ~o); — suposa , ( and supposa), mfn. [ S. lex. supoṣa], easy to nourish or support; Vin III 21, 12 (subharatāya ~-tāya… vaṇṇaṃ bhāsitvā); Sp 222, 10 (subharo hoti ~o); Spk I 115, 29 ; Pj I 241, 5 (sukhena bharīyatī ti subharo, ~o ti vuttaṃ hoti); Th-a III 76, 23 (subharā ti apicchatādibhāvena ~ā).

S: suposatā：f．[su-posa-tā] 易養，給養し易きこと．
